# QS-CFW-4068-79 - Quality specification - bearing ring CFW-4068-79 (52100)
Revision: Rev E  
Supersedes: Rev D  
Plant: P3  
Parts: CFW-4068-79

Scope
This quality specification applies to bearing ring CFW-4068-79 manufactured from material grade 52100 at Plant P3. It defines the critical acceptance criteria, inspection methods, and nonconformance handling for incoming forgings and finished rings produced to part CFW-4068-79.

Requirements table
| Characteristic | Requirement |
|---|---|
| Hardness | The hardness range for bearing ring CFW-4068-79 (CFW-4068-79) is 38-43 HRC. |
| Bore diameter tolerance | The bore diameter tolerance for bearing ring CFW-4068-79 (CFW-4068-79) is ±0.07 mm. |
| Maximum forging weight | The maximum forging weight for bearing ring CFW-4068-79 (CFW-4068-79) is 114.6 kg. |

Inspection method
- Hardness testing: Use a calibrated Rockwell hardness tester appropriate for HRC scale. Perform hardness checks on each production lot at locations representative of the bearing race. Record results in the lot inspection record and verify compliance with the hardness range specified above.
- Dimensional verification: Inspect bore diameter using calibrated bore gauges or micrometers capable of resolving the tolerance stated. Sample frequency shall follow established Plant P3 lot inspection practice and be recorded in the lot inspection record.
- Weight verification: Confirm forging weight against the maximum forging weight stated above at incoming inspection; document weight on the material receiving record.

Nonconformance handling
- Any unit found outside the stated hardness range, outside the bore diameter tolerance, or exceeding the maximum forging weight is nonconforming.
- Segregate nonconforming material immediately and tag with disposition information. Initiate a nonconformance report per Plant P3 procedures and retain inspection records with the report.
- Disposition options include rework if feasible to meet the requirements, or scrap. Final disposition must be approved by quality authority at Plant P3 and documented in the nonconformance report.

Revision note
This revision Rev E supersedes Rev D for use in document control and production.
